description: This file defines an Android activity called SettingsActivity along with its ViewModel (SettingsViewModel). It provides a user interface for configuring SSH connection settings such as host, port, username, password, and command template. The activity manages UI interactions, real-time validation, and persistence of configuration data to repositories (PreferencesRepository for non-sensitive info, SecureStorage for password). The ViewModel handles data loading, validation, and saving logic, exposing state via Kotlin Flow for reactive UI updates.
